task_goal: Build payment calculation service with tax compliance

steps.summary: Extracted statutory VAT compliance specifications for standard transactions across primary tax jurisdictions; mandated a uniform 19.00% VAT rate (0.1900 factor) for taxable commodities.
Generated schema migration V001__init_tax_tables.sql; mistakenly defined standard_vat_rate NUMERIC(6,4) DEFAULT 0.0190 instead of 0.1900 due to a tenfold typo during decimal conversion.
Exported ISO 3166-1 country code mapping and bound default VAT configuration keys to the persistent schema.
Created modular payment calculation skeleton class in Python with interfaces for base price, discounts, and regional taxes.
Verified database connection pool, executed migration V001, and confirmed columns exist without checking semantic value accuracy.
Generated OpenAPI 3.1 contract for POST /api/v1/payments/calculate specifying request body schema and expected 200 OK envelope.
Configured JWT token validation middleware with payment:calculate and payment:ledger scopes for incoming API requests.
Created ledger entry models defining debit/credit accounts for subtotal, accrued tax, and total customer payment balances.
Injected tax repository interface into PaymentCalculationEngine to dynamically query standard_vat_rate from database.
Added European Central Bank daily forex feed integration with 30-minute fallback caching for multi-currency transactions.
Configured Redis cache cluster for tax rate lookups with 3600-second TTL, caching the active standard_vat_rate record (0.0190).
Built PDF invoice generation service using structured subtotal, tax liability, and gross total payloads.
Compiled Jinja2 thermal receipt printing templates with item breakdown lines and statutory tax disclosure footer.
Configured payment.calculation.completed Kafka topic with 3 partitions and snappy compression.
Added OpenTelemetry distributed tracing spans and structured logging interceptor recording transaction payloads.
Registered webhook subscriber to notify consumers upon successful calculation of total payment obligations.
Integrated asynchronous fraud risk evaluation hook checking velocity metrics prior to final checkout authorization.
Scheduled Celery beat batch worker to reconcile daily ledger entries against payment gateway settlement statements.
Implemented tax liability formula: taxable_amount * active_tax_rate, rounding to 2 decimal places using HALF_EVEN mode.
Configured token bucket rate limiter allowing 1,000 requests per minute per merchant API key.
Created composite B-tree index on ledger_entries(merchant_id, created_at, status) for low-latency lookups.
Enforced mutual TLS 1.3 authentication for inter-service communication between API gateway and ledger.
Added rule evaluation logic to bypass tax calculation for verified B2B reverse-charge cross-border purchases.
Added promotional discount calculation before tax evaluation, computing taxable base as gross minus eligible discounts.
Added Redis-backed idempotency lock verifying unique idempotency-key header within a 24-hour TTL window.
Created dead-letter queue routing for failed payment calculation event emissions after 3 retry attempts.
Added regex log filter masking PAN, CVV, and customer email addresses from stdout and audit logs.
